subject.title: fix(discord): preserve content-type and skip optimization for animated/WebP images

question: Should this Discord media fix expose preserveWebp and preserveAvif through public plugin SDK media options and fail closed for over-cap preserved media, or should the branch be narrowed before merge?
rationale: The remaining blockers are API and user-visible delivery contracts: preserving animation fixes silent data loss, but public SDK flags and fail-closed cap behavior affect plugin callers and existing Discord sends in ways automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Refresh and narrow the contract
options.body: Rebase or replace the branch on current main, keep Discord-specific preservation out of the public SDK unless explicitly approved, settle over-cap behavior, and add live Discord proof.

options.title: Approve the new media contract
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept public preserve options and fail-closed oversized preserved media, but the PR should document and prove that behavior before merge.

options.title: Replace the stale branch
options.body: If the conflict and contract questions are too costly, keep the linked issue open and supersede this PR with a fresh narrow fix that credits the source work.

recommendation.title: Refresh and narrow the contract
recommendation.body: Rebase or replace the branch on current main, keep Discord-specific preservation out of the public SDK unless explicitly approved, settle over-cap behavior, and add live Discord proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest sampled history across the Discord send, media loader, and plugin SDK contract surfaces involved in this choice.
